transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Sunday, August 2. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. India win seven gold medals to cap record-breaking boxing campaign in CWG. India finished on top of the boxing medal standings with seven gold and three silver medals, registering its best-ever performance at the Commonwealth Games. Bengal STF probe Jaish man's plot to create trouble at Jantar Mantar. West Bengal Police STF arrested Arpita Sarkar, girlfriend of suspected terrorist Hamim Mondal. Investigators are probing their alleged plan to create disturbances at Jantar Mantar. Hamim was reportedly working under instructions from Pakistani handlers via social media. Arpita is also suspected of involvement in a honey-trap network targeting influential people. E20: AAP plans pro-choice rally to PM residence. Arvind Kejriwal announced a march to the Prime Minister's residence on Tuesday. He demanded consumers have a choice between pure petrol and E20 fuel. Kejriwal also called for E20 fuel to be priced lower than pure petrol. He challenged the government to release scientific studies supporting the E20 fuel policy. Judge Bhuyan questions SC collegium's opacity. Justice Ujjal Bhuyan questioned the Supreme Court collegium's lack of transparency in judicial appointments. He noted that recent collegium resolutions provided no reasons for their decisions. This opacity, he argued, could allow unsuitable individuals to enter the judiciary. Citizens possess a right to know deliberations concerning judicial elevations and transfers. Nuclear plants, Gaza craters: Google pulls AI tool from Google Earth in 24 hours. Google has removed its new AI image generation feature from Google Earth. This action followed immediate concerns raised by researchers about disinformation risks. Experts warned the tool could easily create convincing fake satellite imagery for public deception. Google stated they are implementing stronger safeguards while pausing the feature. Happy Friendship Day 2026: 50 wishes, messages and quotes to share. Friendship Day 2026 falls on Sunday, August 2, celebrating connections. The article offers fifty wishes and quotes for expressing appreciation. These messages cater to heartfelt, funny, and short sentiments for friends. It also includes specific wishes for childhood and long-distance friendships. India-China border trade resumes after 6 years. India and China have reopened two key Himalayan trade routes after six years. Traditional border trade resumed Saturday through Lipulekh and Shipki La passes. Chinese authorities restricted the initial batch of traders to twenty people. Indian traders can export 36 categories of goods, while Chinese traders bring twenty. Vande Bharat's first organ run delivers heart of hope in Ahmedabad. Mithun Swain's heart traveled on a Vande Bharat train after his family donated his organs. This journey marked India's first organ transport via the express train. His heart reached Ahmedabad for a life-saving transplant operation. The railways and Gujarat government coordinated this vital organ delivery. Bomb blast outside Moscow restaurant kills 3, injures 21. At least three people, including a woman carrying a homemade bomb, were killed and 21 others injured after an explosive device detonated outside an Italian restaurant in central Moscow on Saturday. Monsoon hope as WMO sees an El Niño counter. India faces a risk of below-normal monsoon rainfall due to El Niño. A positive Indian Ocean Dipole may offer some relief to the country. This oceanic pattern could improve rainfall conditions in southern India. It might prevent the monsoon from slipping into a deficient phase. World's largest digital camera captures more than 500,000 galaxies in deep view of universe. The Vera C. Rubin Observatory has released a stunning image of the COSMOS field. This image contains over half a million galaxies and fifty thousand stars. Astronomers have studied this specific sky region for over two decades.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Bhopal Municipal Corporation's Sealing Drive Sparks Selective Action Row As Arera Colony Escapes Crackdown. Bhopal Municipal Corporation's drive against commercial establishments operating from residential premises triggered allegations of selective enforcement after action remained confined to Rohit Nagar and Bawadiya Kalan, while Arera Colony saw no sealing. MPBSE Relaxes Class 9 Age Rule After High Court Case; Students Below 13 Now Eligible. The Madhya Pradesh Board of Secondary Education has relaxed the minimum age requirement for Class 9 admissions in the 2026-27 session after parents' complaints and a High Court case. MP Identifies 23 Ram Van Gaman Sites Across 9 Districts, Plans rupees 5,289-Crore Chitrakoot Revamp. A Ram Gaman Path survey has identified 23 sites linked to Lord Ram's exile across nine Madhya Pradesh districts. Junior Officers Get Large Districts, Seniors Posted To Small Places. Madhya Pradesh has departed from its traditional collector posting pattern by assigning 2013-batch IAS officers to major districts such as Bhopal, Indore and Jabalpur, while several senior officers have been posted to smaller districts. Officials From 9 States Visit Indore To Replicate India's Cleanest City Model. Twenty-six senior officials from nine states visited Indore on a three-day AMDA study tour to learn its award-winning cleanliness and waste management model. Nissan Gravite On Road Price Bhopal Aug 2026. 3 cases with minor girls in a day in Bhopal: Auto driver molests 10-year-old on way to school. Two Labourers Killed After Bike Crashes Into Parked Dumper In Indore; Teen Dies In Separate Accident. Three people were killed in two separate road accidents in Indore. Daily Madhya Pradesh Current Affairs for MPPSC Exam (02-08-2026). Air India Express commences operations from Bhopal with daily flights to Delhi and Mumbai. Madhya Pradesh pole vaulter Kuldeep Kumar breaks national record at Bhubaneswar. Tragic boat capsizes at Bargi Dam during evening storm in Madhya Pradesh. Youth Congress Protests VIP Darshan At Mahakal Temple, Demands Equal Access For Devotees. Youth Congress leaders protested outside Shri Mahakaleshwar Temple in Ujjain, demanding an end to VIP privileges and greater transparency in darshan arrangements. 2 dozen commercial establishments locked in residential areas. Thieves steal fake jewellery from MLA's residence. Poaching trail widens as leopard bones, traps seized in MP. Rape case registered against Nirmohi Akhada Mahamandaleshwar. Air India Express begins operations from Bhopal.
